about_the_game:
Five Biggest Accomplishments is a short Visual Novel where you play as someone who has held the same job for 30 years: push a button every 8 hours or the world will end. Suddenly, you get an email asking you to list your five biggest accomplishments for the week, or risk being fired.

  • Discover the secrets behind UGO

    The Unnamed Government Office hides many mysteries and secrets. Where did it come from? What is its true purpose? Just how old is Dr. Restoy really?

  • Play as different characters

    Find out more about what is happening by playing as different characters and seeing the story from different angles, including a particular billonaire with a penchant for big ideas and an interest in efficiency.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game deals with political themes of government funding and spending.
The game includes an eerie atmosphere and elements of light existential horror.
